shell.signOutHeldTitle: Sign out and discard held tickets?
shell.signOutHeldBody_one: There is {{count}} held ticket on this device. Held tickets are never sent to the server, so signing out discards it. Recorded orders and sales are not affected.
shell.signOutHeldBody_other: There are {{count}} held tickets on this device. Held tickets are never sent to the server, so signing out discards them. Recorded orders and sales are not affected.

demo.disclaimer: Presentation mode: every sales, order, inventory and alert figure on this dashboard is illustrative and does not represent this organization's results. Sales recorded at the POS, payments, inventory and finance remain real and are shown again when you leave presentation mode.

presentation.startHint: Show illustrative data for a demonstration (no record is changed)
presentation.bannerBody: The dashboard, notifications, stores and kitchen screen show fictional figures for a demonstration. Sales, payments, inventory and finance remain real and are not changed by this mode.
